title: Rockies Grand Adventure to Moraine and Louise Lakes Tour
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: Travel time is included on the total duration
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover the stunning beauty of the Canadian Rockies on this 12-hour adventure, featuring iconic Moraine Lake and Lake Louise. Explore the breathtaking Takakkaw Falls and capture unforgettable moments at the Banff Town Sign. This tour offers a comfortable air-conditioned vehicle, complete with WiFi, snacks, and beverages. Expert guides provide insights into the region's history and natural wonders, ensuring an enriching experience for travelers. Ideal for nature enthusiasts and photographers alike, this tour has a maximum of 14 participants to maintain an intimate atmosphere.

- Visit Moraine Lake and Lake Louise for breathtaking views
- Enjoy Takakkaw Falls and a stop at the Banff Town Sign
- Includes breakfast, lunch, snacks, and beverages
- Small group size (maximum of 14 travelers) for a personal experience
